project_type: PyQt6 desktop application with plugin backends (AppImage, Flatpak, Pacman)
build_system: hatchling (pyproject.toml), no separate compile step required
test_framework: pytest with pytest-qt for Qt testing
test_command: ./check (runs ruff check, ruff format --check, then pytest)
verification_instructions: Run ./check after each feature. All 302+ tests must pass with 0 ruff violations. Check that pytest runs without import errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No build artifacts are committed.
environment_constraints: Never run pkg as subprocess in production paths (only via PkgdClient RPC). The runner parameter is for pacman read-only commands (pacman -Si, -Qi, -Qq). Tests run against a private D-Bus session (see tests/conftest.py). aurelis_common.rpc.PkgdClient must be imported inside functions (not module-level) for graceful degradation when aurelis_common is unavailable.
contribution_requirements: Match code style of backends/flatpak.py and services/flathub_index.py exactly. Pure Python in core/ and backends/ (no Qt). Qt only in ui/ and services/qt_*.py. All backend operations use the Operation pattern (see backends/base.py). Type hints required. Docstrings for public APIs. Module-level command constants as list[str] (never shell strings).
key_patterns: 1) Backend pattern: FlatpakBackend (backends/flatpak.py) with CommandRunner injection, module-level command constants, _default_runner using subprocess, Operation-returning methods (install/remove/update). 2) Index pattern: FlathubIndex (services/flathub_index.py) with sqlite3 + FTS5, needs_rebuild checking mtime, rebuild with progress_cb, search/get methods, _fts_query helper. 3) Model pattern: FlathubModel (ui/app_model.py) with canFetchMore/fetchMore pagination, same roles as AppModel. 4) Wiring pattern: main_window.py __init__ creates backend + index, _refresh_installed merges sources, operations queue managed centrally.
directory_structure: src/aurelis_software/{core/,backends/,services/,ui/} — core has models + paths, backends implement Backend ABC, services have indexes and Qt adapters, ui has widgets. tests/ mirrors src structure. No tests/fixtures/ directory exists yet; create tests/fixtures/pacman/ for parser test data.
